data.narrative:
Wispr AI is a Series A–stage AI & Software company founded by Tanay Kothari and Sahaj Garg that has raised $81.6M to date. The peer universe consists of nine comparable companies across AI & Software—one public (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and eight private firms including Scale AI, Reflection AI, Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, and Field AI, spanning Series A through Series B stages.

Two valuation methods are applicable. The stage-progression approach uses the $82M total raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yielding $163M. The peer-median method examines five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $2.0B (Field AI) to $29.0B (Scale AI), producing a median valuation of $5.6B.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $139M to $6.4B, with a median of $2.9B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty in comparable selection and stage-specific benchmarking. The peer-median approach carries substantial weight given the active market for frontier AI, but the peer set exhibits extreme dispersion—a two-order-magnitude spread that reflects heterogeneity in product maturity, capital efficiency, and revenue scale across the cohort. Stage-progression methods provide a lower bound but assume typical progression rates that may not hold in faster-moving segments. Revenue and growth metrics would be critical to narrow this range.
